title: Ktmoney's "Screw Love" is a super dope record that the world should hear
htmlContent:
Ktmoney's "Screw Love" is a super dope record that the world should hear. The music is packed with appeal, with a sound that is digestible for the masses, while still being a master class of emceeing that showcases his talent to the fullest on this breakout record.

The song has many great elements that work, but one of the more impressive elements is the writing. What can be a lost art for some, he excels majorly in with him mastering the art of tone in the vocals to make them felt even more.
